title: One month with Claude, Unity, Blender, and Meshy — building a playable co-op veterinary game
author: PixelPawsInt
selftext:
I've spent the last month building Trauma Room, a veterinary hospital game for 1–4 players, using Claude alongside Unity, Blender, and the Meshy API. Here's the first trailer.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5393520/Trauma\_Room/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5393520/Trauma_Room/)
